settings.heading: Six pieces, one of each
settings.empty_body: Contact us to enquire about a featured piece.

settings.heading: Have a piece to sell?
settings.body: We buy statues outright — no commission, and we don't sell on your behalf. Tell us what you have and we'll come back with an offer.

settings.title: The exact statue in the photos
settings.text: Every photograph is of the piece you receive, not a studio render. One of each — when it's gone, it's gone.

settings.title: Boxed, and described honestly
settings.text: Pre-owned and supplied with its original box. Condition is written as it is, and we'll send more photographs of any detail before you buy.

settings.title: Free collection in London
settings.text: Collect yours at no charge, usually ready within 24 hours. Ask about delivery before you order and we'll quote your address.

settings.title: Choose your piece
settings.text: Order online. Ask us anything first — we'll send extra photographs of any detail.

settings.title: We prepare it
settings.text: Usually ready within 24 hours. We'll email you when it's ready and arrange a time that suits you.

settings.title: Collect it, free
settings.text: Collect from us in London at no charge. Bring your confirmation and photo ID. These pieces are heavy, so bring suitable transport and a second pair of hands for the larger ones.

settings.title: Not in London?
settings.text: Ask about delivery before you order and we'll quote your address. Personal UK delivery with optional in-home assembly is coming.

settings.heading: How it reaches you
settings.body: A statue is not a parcel. Here is exactly what happens between your order and the piece standing in your home.
settings.image_alt: Red Roc Luffy resin statue by Monkey D Studio
settings.caption: Red Roc Luffy, 1/6 scale — the piece as it stands today.

settings.heading: The Hassle-Free Handover Guarantee
settings.body:
You'll receive the exact statue shown in the listing, in the condition described and with all the parts listed. If it arrives damaged, a listed part is missing, or the statue differs from its description, you can return it for a full refund — and we'll arrange and pay for collection.

Your statutory rights are unaffected.
